title: Wavelength comments (review.json)
description: Comments on a Wavelength song, format version 1.0 (docs/song-format.md, Draft 2, section 7). I-JSON: no key twice in an object. Comment ids are unique within the file (checked by validators). Accepts both the current comment shape (anchor, replies, resolved) and comments written before the spec, whose anchor fields sit on the comment itself, whose render is a number and whose single reply is a string. Times written before the spec use a UTC offset without a colon (2026-09-26T21:23:40-0400), so comment times are not held to RFC 3339 here. CC0.

hashRef.description: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits, as writers write it. A value with another algorithm's prefix is unsupported, not invalid (section 6).

kind.description: Known values: human (the default), ai. Readers read a kind they don't know as human.

timeRange.description: [start, end] in seconds of the rendered mix, its lead-in included.

beatRange.description: [start, end] in beats, counted from the job's beat 0.

anchorNote.description: A note is identified by its track, start beat and key (MIDI number).

legacyNote.description: Notes in comments written before the spec: key may be a name such as A4, with the MIDI number in midi.

anchor.description: What was heard when the comment was written. Never rewritten. Comments from before the format have no revision.

ref.description: A human-readable reference, such as 'bars 53-56 · 2:17-2:24 · Build'.

author.description: Tools SHOULD write it; replies from before the format have none.

status.description: Known values: open, done. Readers read a status they don't know as open.

ref.description: Legacy: anchor.ref on the comment itself.

render.description: Legacy: an identifier of the render that was playing (not a hash).
